```{r isochrone-map}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

options(java.parameters = "-Xmx4G")
library(r5r)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# Build network
r5r_core <- r5r::build_network(data_path = "D:/Final-Project/DATA")

# Pick one school in Galway city centre as the focal point
schools_sf <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/schools_sf.rds") %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Use one central Galway school as origin
origin <- data.frame(
  id  = "school",
  lon = -9.0568,
  lat = 53.2707
)

# Calculate isochrones
iso <- r5r::isochrone(
  r5r_core = r5r_core,
  origins  = origin,
  mode     = "WALK",
  cutoffs  = c(10, 20, 30)
)

r5r::stop_r5(r5r_core)

# Colours per zone
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#2ca25f", "#fed976", "#fd8d3c"),
  levels  = c(10, 20, 30)
)

# Map
leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

  # Travel time zones
  addPolygons(
    data        = iso,
    fillColor   = ~pal(cutoff),
    fillOpacity = 0.5,
    color       = "white",
    weight      = 1,
    label       = ~paste0("Within ", cutoff, " min walk"),
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      fillOpacity = 0.8,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%

  # Focal school
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng         = -9.0568,
    lat         = 53.2707,
    radius      = 10,
    color       = "#9f1f55",
    fillColor   = "#9f1f55",
    fillOpacity = 1,
    stroke      = TRUE,
    weight      = 2,
    popup       = "Focal school — origin point"
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    colors   = c("#2ca25f", "#fed976", "#fd8d3c"),
    labels   = c("0–10 min", "10–20 min", "20–30 min"),
    title    = "Walking time from school",
    position = "bottomright"
  ) %>%

  setView(lng = -9.0568, lat = 53.2707, zoom = 14)
```
